scope: 1000 字 Part 1 固定順序前 10 字；不影響其他單字或 2000 字字書。

generation.description: AI 生成的虛構圖片，不是真實事件照片。每張只表達教材中的一個意思，不能取代完整中文解釋。

preparation.alterations: 僅縮小與壓縮，未裁切或改動畫面內容。

verification.mapping: 以資料中的 id 對應圖片；已確認等於 Part 1 按 deckPosition 排序的前 10 字。
verification.assets: 10 張原圖由圖片生成代理檢視；主代理另檢視選用圖片。
verification.browser: 尚未執行瀏覽器版面或手機實機測試。

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square word-meaning picture displayed about 100–160 CSS pixels beside a Chinese definition on a vocabulary flashcard.
Style/medium: ONE standalone square, clean semi-realistic editorial illustration with natural proportions, simple clear scene and strong recognizable focal action, minimal background clutter. Adult learning audience, not babyish clip art.
Lighting/mood: soft natural lighting.
Color palette: natural greens, warm wood/ochre and blue tones fitting an off-white/dark-green app; scene must remain readable at small size.
Constraints: Not a UI screenshot. No written words, letters, numerals, arrows, labels, logos, watermark or decorative border. Do not print the target word. Original fictional scene with one concrete meaning cue only, not all dictionary senses.
Primary request: prodigal means 非常浪費的、揮霍的, spending resources too freely. A carefree adult frivolously throwing banknotes into the air while surrounded by excessive shopping bags and barely-used luxury purchases. Clear wasteful spending, not donation or charity; no readable currency marks. Simplify background, focus on spender and unnecessary purchases.
assets.inspection: Intended wasteful spending cue is clear. Small incidental currency marks and partial gold letter-like marks on a shopping bag; no recognizable brand name. Checkered brown handbag evokes established luxury styling without identifying logo. Not a strict no-text pass; root advised incidental non-salient currency numerals acceptable. Photorealistic style accepted by root.
